title: Neon Market: Themed Shops for Cyberpunk RED
description: Full-screen, themed shop encounters for the Cyberpunk RED - CORE system. Put a clerk on stage, stock the shelves by drag and drop, and run GM-mediated eurobuck trades with buy, sell and buyback.

recommends.reason: Tech shop repairs fix the Damaged, Destroyed and malfunctioning gear Neon At Home tracks.
Tech shops repair and upgrade vehicles on MMuton's Vehicle Actor Sheet: SDP, plating, bulletproof glass and vehicle critical injuries.
